150053568350107_1507206884762927 feeds_service September 18, 2026 At the Saskatchewan Nuclear Energy Forum in Toronto this week, Cameco CEO Tim Gitzel joined Scott Moe and former Prime Minister Stephen Harper for a fireside chat on leading global nuclear industry development. The forum highlighted Saskatchewan's strengths across the nuclear value chain, from world-class uranium resources to innovation and supply chain development. We're thrilled to be part of the growing momentum behind nuclear energy and the discussions shaping its future. 150053568350107_1509041217912827 feeds_service September 18, 2026 We were proud to join industry colleagues, students and future leaders at the Women in Mining and Women in Nuclear Saskatchewan Inc. - WIM/WiN-SK Mine Your Potential Conference yesterday. The event brought together people from across Saskatchewan's mining and nuclear sectors for a day of connection, learning and inspiration. We're especially proud of our own Monica Kwong, who served as WIM/WiN-SK Vice Chair and co-emcee, helping guide a day filled with meaningful conversations and valuable networking opportunities.
